people.name: Jotham
people.line: King of Judah and son of Uzziah

translations.web: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before Yahweh his God.
translations.bsb: So Jotham grew powerful because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God.
translations.kjv: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.
translations.asv: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before Jehovah his God.
